title: Orbits of the three-body problem with large potential
summary: Consider the planar three-body problem with masses positive $m_1,m_2,m_3$ position vector $q(t) = (q_1(t),q_2(t),q_3(t))\in\mathbb{R}^6$. Let $$U(q) = \frac{m_1m_2}{r_{12}}+\frac{m_1m_3}{r_{13}}+\frac{m_2m_3}{r_{23}}$$ where $r_{ij}=|q_i-q_j|$. Assume that the angular momentum is nonzero so that triple collision is impossible and fix any negative energy.. Then given any constant $K>0$ there are solutions with $U(q(t))\ge K$ for all $t\in\mathbb{R}$. These solutions will have a single close approach to triple collision.
